## Readiness checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the documented public component boundary.
- [ ] Browser permissions remain least-privilege and any permission change is documented.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and storage changes include a compatible migration.
- [ ] User-facing copy is localized in every supported language.
- [ ] README, privacy documentation, and changelog are updated when applicable.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private-product references, generated output, or local configuration are included.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, maintained, correctly scoped, and license-compatible.
- [ ] Asset provenance has no unresolved rights status for changed or newly distributed assets.
- [ ] Packaged third-party notices cover every dependency distributed in each changed release ZIP.
